messages:
nina: noticing bursty p99 on embeddings in eu-west1 after the quant rollout at 15:50 UTC. small customer impact but actionable.
omar: can you share the query pattern? long-seq vs short?
nina: mostly long-seq (>1024) sandboxed jobs. dashboard: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/embeds?region=eu-west1
tia: ops risk? any danger to SLAs?
nina: error rate up 0.25%, p99 +30% on tails. recommend emergency pin to v2.2.8 and adjust batch window to 20ms.
release_manager: need expedited approval from SRE + release mgr to proceed. provide rollout plan and rollback one-liner.
sre_oncall: I can approve quick canary as long as deployment is staged and we have a rollback command.
omar: infra check: capacity ok for a staged pin. suggest canary 2% -> 15% -> full.
release_manager: draft release note: 
```n
Hotfix (expedited): revert embeddings model in eu-west1 from v2.3.1-quant to v2.2.8 and reduce batching window to 20ms to mitigate p99 latency spike.
```n
nina: deploybot, initiate hotpatch: service=embeddings env=prod region=eu-west1 from=v2.3.1-quant to=v2.2.8 owner=omar
deploybot: @omar scheduled deploy id=dr-1764129999-x. strategy=staged-canary slices=[2%,15%,100%] checks=[health, p95,p99,5xx]. wait for manual approval between stages.
release_manager: posting changelog entry and tagging billing. tia: enable extra alerting and customer comms if needed.
omar: starting canary 2%. logs: dr-1764129999-x canary-start
sre_oncall: watching metrics. abort criteria: 5xx > 0.5% OR p99 up > 25% sustained 5m.
omar: 7m in: p95 down 12%, p99 down 22%, 5xx unchanged. green to proceed to 15%.
deploybot: progressing to 15% slice.
release_manager: I've updated the incident board and notified sales for impacted customers. question: do we need to pin traffic rather than image to avoid config drift?
nina: pinning image is enough for now; we'll follow up with config audit.
release_manager: rollback command (one-liner):
```n
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/embeddings --to-revision=deploy-v2.3.1-quant && kubectl rollout status -n prod deploy/embeddings
```n
tia: if canary fails, initiate rollback and open SEV1 channel.
sre_oncall: I approve proceed to full if 15% stable for 10m.
omar: 15% stable at 12m, no regression. advancing to 100%.
deploybot: deploy complete: dr-1764129999-x -> slices=100% status=success.
release_manager: marking hotfix as expedited/critical in change log. will add postmortem once RCA done. thanks team :thumbsup:
nina: follow-up next steps: RCA (ML infra + model infra), add regression test for long-seq quantized paths, consider auto-pin safety for bursts.
omar: noted, closing thread on deploy.
